title: Tree search/filter box unusable after connecting to an RDP session (RDP ActiveX Win32 focus)
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

After connecting to a device (e.g. RDP) from the connection tree, the **search / filter box** at the top of the connection tree becomes unusable — clicking it and typing does nothing while the RDP tab is the active connection. In mRemoteNG 1.77.3 the search box stayed usable.

Reported by @happpyg in #139 (split out as its own issue).

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks — those answers nailed it, especially "works again as soon as the RDP connection is closed" and "happens with SSH too." That points straight at OS-level keyboard focus.

**Root cause:** the RDP client is an ActiveX control and PuTTY is a native window embedded into the tab; while either is the active connection it holds the real (Win32) keyboard focus. comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the follow-up test. The Help -> About clue exposed a second focus path that the first fix did not cover.

The original change handled direct mouse activation of the search box. When an embedded RDP or PuTTY window owns native focus, reactivating mRemoteNG can instead arrive through the top-level window activation path, so WinForms still believes the search box is focused while Windows keeps keyboard focus in the embedded session.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for testing again and for the About-dialog observation — that detail cracked it.

The two earlier fixes were aimed at the wrong layer. Windows keyboard focus is **per-thread** state: `SetFocus` from the app's UI thread only updates that thread's own input queue. But while an RDP session is active, the actual keyboard input is owned by a different thread entirely (the RDP control's input window runs on its own worker thread; with PuTTY it's even a separate process).
